proposed_changes.change: Phase 257 turns the recorded remedy -- never admin-merge with any check pending -- from a rule someone remembers into a question one command answers. classify() separates pending-because-running from pending-because-waiting-on-a-human, defaults to deny so an unrecognized bucket or state blocks rather than reading as green, and treats an empty check list as NO_CHECKS. The normative rule is doctrine-governance-enforcement.md section 17, which /qor-substantiate Step 9.6 cites. The control is detective and procedural, not preventive: --admin exists to bypass branch protection, and release_ci_gate continues to gate the downstream publish.
